'''Cularin's disappearance''' occurred when the [[Darkstaff]] was activated. The entire [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] vanished from the galaxy, only to [[Time travel/Legends|reemerge ten years later]] to a changed galaxy enthralled in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The first person to return to Cularin was [[Devan For'deschel]].<ref name="Devan article">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030619devan|text=Devan}}</ref>

The event was colloquially known by some within the Cularin system as '''the Blink'''.<ref name="Trammel's Move">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20031204trammel|text=Trammel's Move}}</ref>

{{Event-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This event occurred to move the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force campaign]] forward ten years so that it coincided with the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
